state: A coding agent may write approximate Can after seeing only a tiny Given/When/Then primer. The planned dev server should return one compact canonical help card when justified and abstain where intent is unclear. Today diagnostics carry stable code, source byte span/hash and completeness; current completion is positional but is not a reliable expected-token oracle on recovered or unknown syntax. An observed six-draft corpus shows structural failures, case-shaped type guesses, `rule` meaning policy/invariant/lock/derive, and `atomic` with no safe one-word replacement. The catalog supplies versioned candidate IDs and fixed signatures/meanings; Jev Choice only selects among criteria and returns probabilities/confidence. Consider useful completion, semantic misguidance, API calls, response time and limited external source sharing.

ranking_trigger.instructions: Choose a default Jev invocation policy for construct suggestions in a check response.

criteria.request_only: Show deterministic grammar and catalog guidance by default, with a separate explicit Jev request for ambiguous diagnostics. Strong cost and privacy control, but one extra tool round trip for the common ambiguous case.
criteria.all_eligible_errors: Call Jev for each diagnostic that has a plausible supported construct card. Maximizes automatic coverage, while duplicating exact parser guidance and increasing time/cost when recovery context is unreliable.
criteria.ambiguous_after_deterministic: Call Jev for a bounded set of multiple viable cards only after exact grammar, signature and contextual matches have been used; require reliable source location and preserve none/unclear. Saves routine calls but depends on careful candidate filtering.

ranking_context.instructions: Choose the normal Jev payload for intent ranking among supplied Can cards.

criteria.bounded_context: Include code/span/section and candidate summaries with a short redacted local source excerpt, relevant typed declarations and optional agent-stated task intent; do not send whole files or private runtime data. Balances disambiguation and exposure.
criteria.full_context: Include complete file, declaration graph and user task with the candidates. Can aid broad interpretation but sends more project data and costs more tokens and latency.
criteria.structured_only: Include only diagnostic metadata, grammar position and parallel candidate summaries. Minimal provider data, but weak clues for invented vocabulary and intended operation.
